_rule: Guardrail G7: only items with status 'confirmed' may be built into the app. Everything else is link-out only until the owner confirms terms in writing.

PHQ-9.terms: No permission required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute (Pfizer).

GAD-7.terms: No permission required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute (Pfizer).

ICD-10-CM.terms: US government code set (CDC/CMS). NLM Clinical Tables API is free and provided as-is.

ICD-11.terms: Free; ICD-API requires registration and OAuth2 client credentials. Follow WHO licensing terms.

PCL-5.terms: Believed free from the National Center for PTSD. Confirm before building in.

AUDIT.terms: WHO instrument, believed free. Confirm before building in.

ISI.terms: Copyrighted; license likely required for commercial software.

PSWQ.terms: Penn State Worry Questionnaire (Meyer et al., 1990). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

APA Severity Measures.terms: APA online assessment measures, including the disorder-specific severity measures (panic, agoraphobia, generalized anxiety). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

C-SSRS.terms: Check permission terms for software use.

Stanley-Brown Safety Plan.terms: Not built in. Electronic use of the Stanley-Brown form needs the authors' written permission, which has not been obtained. The app's own safety-plan worksheet (/tools/safety-plan) follows the app's own safety-plan handout (content/handouts/safety-plan.json): original headings, reasons to keep going first, company and help merged into one 'Connect with people' part, the safer-space part before 'Get help now', and six parts instead of the form's steps. It says it is not the Stanley-Brown form and only links to the authors' site. Clinical and legal review of this structure is still pending.

MDQ.terms: Mood Disorder Questionnaire (Hirschfeld et al., 2000). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

ASRS.terms: WHO Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale (ASRS-5). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

MSI-BPD.terms: McLean Screening Instrument for Borderline Personality Disorder (Zanarini et al., 2003). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

SCOFF.terms: SCOFF eating disorder screen (Morgan et al., 1999). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

EDE-Q.terms: Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (Fairburn and Beglin). Copyrighted; check permission for commercial software; link out only.

PQ-B.terms: Prodromal Questionnaire-Brief (Loewy et al., 2011). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

SHAI.terms: Short Health Anxiety Inventory (Salkovskis et al., 2002). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

PHQ-15.terms: PHQ-15 somatic symptom scale (Kroenke et al., 2002), part of the PHQ family. Believed to share the PHQ-9 terms; the owner must confirm before it is built in. Link out only.

HRS.terms: Hoarding Rating Scale-Interview (Tolin et al., 2010). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

BDDQ.terms: Body Dysmorphic Disorder Questionnaire (Phillips). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

CUDIT-R.terms: Cannabis Use Disorders Identification Test-Revised (Adamson et al., 2010). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

DAST-10.terms: Drug Abuse Screening Test (Skinner, 1982). Copyrighted; check permission for commercial software; link out only.

COWS.terms: Clinical Opiate Withdrawal Scale (Wesson and Ling, 2003), clinician-rated. Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

DSM-5-TR text.terms: APA copyright. Software license required; no input into AI tools without written permission.

Wiley PracticePlanners.terms: Wiley copyright; licensed commercially to EHRs.
